column1: # Known differences, each owned by an open issue: KIND NAME ADAPTER ISSUE WANT NOTE, separated by tabs.
# WANT is the exact failure excused: "LINE: what the adapter printed" for a case, the -/+ lines against the reference for a describe.
# Any other failure of the same case still fails, and an entry that stops failing fails the run until it is removed.
